description: Header file defining internal structures and functions for parsing floating-point numbers from strings in the Abseil library.

classes.name: ParsedFloat
classes.description: Structure representing the components of a parsed floating-point number, including mantissa, exponent, and type.

methods.name: ParseFloat
methods.description: Template function to parse a floating-point number from a string range, supporting decimal (base 10) and hexadecimal (base 16) formats.
